verdict.rationale: Windmill is a developer platform with a programmatic API, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence shows no versioned API scheme and no documented deprecation policy. The version-pinned webhooks target a specific version of a user's own flow, not a versioned platform API, so they are only an adjacent feature, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
